messages.text: Path A — the local backend: no sandboxing, no isolation, no resource limits (its docstring says so)
Path B — a BaseSandbox partner (Daytona / Modal / Runloop / Vercel): the same call, isolated
Same tool, same stack — and with the default StateBackend the tool is filtered out of the request entirely

subtitle: The execute tool is a backend capability — where it runs is a construction choice
title: Two ways to run a shell command
